Inside the SQL query itself, run by SQL Server

questions.q: What does passing chunksize to pd.read_sql() change?

questions.q: Why is pushing a join down into SQL generally preferred over joining in pandas?
options: It avoids moving more data than needed across the network and lets the database do what it's optimized for
Pandas cannot perform joins under any circumstances
SQL joins are always invalid syntax
There is no difference in performance
questions.explain: Pulling full tables into Python just to join them wastes both network and compute effort the database already handles well.

questions.q: What should you avoid doing when building a SQL query string in Python, according to this lesson?
options: Using ORDER BY clauses
Running the query more than once
Splicing user-supplied or external values directly into the query string with an f-string
